Subject: Measure R: Contract Agreement: California Multiple Award Schedule Contract #4-23-12-1011 - Cambrian Community Center HVAC
District Priorities:
Enclosure

CSD CCC HVAC & Roof - Ascent CMAS Agreement 26-10-15 rev.pdf
Summary: California Public Contract Code (PCC) §§ 10298 and 10299 authorize local government agencies and school districts to use California Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS) agreements to procure goods and services without competitive bidding. CMAS vendors and manufacturers are required to honor prices that do not exceed those established under the applicable CMAS agreement, allowing public agencies to procure equipment and supplies efficiently and cost-effectively. As part of Measure R, the District will replace the HVAC system at the Cambrian Community Center, located between Price Middle School and Fammatre Elementary School. To support this project, the District proposes to purchase HVAC equipment, supplies, and related materials through California Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS) agreements. Estimated Agreement: Not to Exceed $319,973.72
Funding:
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Governing Board approve an agreement with Lennox Industries, Inc. under the California Multiple Award Schedules pricing and contract provisions.
